rateLimits.note: "No more than one request every three seconds", across all the caller's machines combined (legacy APIs: arXiv API, OAI-PMH, RSS).

provenance.notes: Read on arXiv's API Terms of Use page on 2026-11-10: one request every three seconds, a single connection at a time, limits apply to all machines together. Descriptive metadata is under CC0 1.0; the e-prints themselves remain under their authors' copyright (redistribution needs the holder's permission), which the rights here do not cover. No attribution wording, no caching rule, no User-Agent requirement stated. No rate-limit headers seen on a test call.
